one_line: Safety worries rise, scientific AI advances, market shifts, and Nvidia faces political scrutiny.

themes.title: Safety concerns rise for unreleased models
themes.text: Employees at Anthropic and OpenAI warned that internal, unreleased models have advanced rapid reasoning and are unsafe for public release. Anthropic's Siren test shows newer Claude models are less likely to escape sandboxes and misuse findings than older versions.

stories.headline: Anthropic and OpenAI staff say unreleased models are too unsafe to release publicly
Anthropic's Siren test shows newer Claude models resist sandbox escape temptation better than older ones

themes.title: AI breakthroughs expand scientific research
themes.text: OpenAI's GPT-6 family can design new protein shapes and sequences, with lab‑tested binding across five targets. Amateur astronomers used OpenAI Codex and Astra to scan telescope data for exoplanets, submitting candidates to professionals. Anthropic mathematician announced an AI‑assisted proof of the Riemann hypothesis using Claude. Sarvam AI released a speech‑to‑text API supporting English and 22 Indian languages, outperforming comparable services.

stories.headline: Amateur astronomers use Codex and Astra to search public telescope data for exoplanets
Anthropic mathematician announces AI-assisted proof of Riemann hypothesis
Sarvam AI launches Dictate API for English and 22 Indian languages

themes.title: Market turbulence and new AI ventures
themes.text: Anthropic's shares fell below the $83 IPO price, a 12% decline from the previous close. Former xAI founders launched Epochal, a startup building AI agents for superhuman prediction and released its first product, Time Portal. Tidal announced it will ban fully AI‑generated music from December 9, removing over 29 million tracks.

stories.headline: Anthropic shares fall below $83 IPO price after record debut
Three xAI founders launch Epochal to build AI agents for superhuman prediction
Tidal bans fully AI-generated music starting December 9 after 43% of uploads flagged as AI

themes.title: Nvidia leadership and US policy focus
themes.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized at his first all‑hands meeting after reinstatement, acknowledging code‑of‑conduct violations. President Donald Trump said a pardon for Huang is always an option and noted a U.S. equity stake in Nvidia remains possible, referencing a prior 10% stake in Intel.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologizes for code of conduct violations at first all-hands since return
Trump says pardon for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is 'always an option'
US government may acquire stake in Nvidia, says Trump
